name: stockflow-rerecord
description: Inventory app re-captured end-to-end on the current Consort kit (design + build lanes both live, including the DBA design-lane role). Two sprints on one project: sprint 1 builds F1 record-stock visibility, sprint 2 builds F6 split tracking-code (expand/contract column drop). Planning lane authors the feature-requests live; the human proxy supplies the 3 intake files and auto-approves every gate. A contiguous, error-free state-machine regression corpus.
